changelog: Aura AI v2.4.8 — Image Generation UI/UX Redesign, WhatsApp Auto-Reply & Fresh Chat Context Fix

Complete Image Generation UI/UX Flow: Dedicated Image Mode composer with aspect ratio selector (1:1, 16:9, 9:16, 4:3, 3:4), expandable settings sheet, reference attachments, shimmer loading card, hero/multi-image result grid, action toolbar, dark fullscreen zoom/swipe lightbox, and conversational follow-up editing
WhatsApp Notification Auto-Reply (#18): Smart Confirm default with live voice cards + Direct Auto-Reply toggle via AuraNotificationListenerService and quick notification confirm/cancel actions
Fresh New Chat Context Isolation: Prevented stale project context (e.g. older project names) from leaking into brand-new casual conversations
Automation, YouTube Search & Browser MCP Refinements: Improved YouTube HTML/lockup video parsing, domain normalization, MCQ grounding, and browser viewport/input controls
